units.source_text: 我站在正门南的雪光的反射中，脸颊在发烧。

en.t: I stood in the reflected glow of the snow south of the main gate, my cheeks burning.

units.source_text: 吉普车扬起了一阵烟雪，慢慢地摇晃着远去了。

en.t: The jeep threw up a cloud of powdery snow and slowly swayed away into the distance.

units.source_text: 看不见吉普车了，我的肉体却亢奋起来。

en.t: Once the jeep was out of sight, my body instead grew excited.
